statements.basis: procedure_code and diagnosis_codes fields in submitted records
statements.statement: The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
The patient has recurrent episodes of syncope (R55)
The patient's symptoms are not adequately captured by standard ambulatory monitoring
The claim was denied with reason code CO-97
The denial is based on the service being bundled into another covered procedure
Cardiac event monitoring is indicated for extended rhythm assessment to correlate symptoms with underlying arrhythmias
